scope_and_interpretation: These are official reported tender announcements and estimated full-contract/option values, not realized public spending, supplier invoices, supplier revenue or AgentMine addressable software revenue.

The 2025 increase in estimated value is much larger than the increase in notice counts. The underlying distribution, individual outliers and any data revisions have not been checked; do not infer typical contract size growth, unique buyers or supplier concentration.
Main CPV72 excludes software/system notices whose main code is CPV48 and notices with only secondary CPV72; it cannot be combined with the fixed any-CPV72 TED cohort as a shared denominator.
No independently observed supplier willingness to pay for AgentMine, paid users, saved decision time, actual variable cost or conversion is established by these annual statistics.
The sources are 2026 publications describing historical 2024 and 2025 cohorts, not new tenders observed in October 2026.
